summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 59 (fuse-ipns-verify-publish-hardening-and-cleanup) to produce verified PLAN.md files via the full research → plan → verify pipeline.
summary.outcome: All four plans were produced and passed plan-checker verification after one mechanical fix iteration. STATE and ROADMAP were updated and committed to the correct feature branch.

repo: gsd-planner creates a stray `docs/plan-phase-<N>` branch instead of committing to the active feat/<slug> branch — a documented GSD gotcha requiring manual consolidation after every planning run.

The commit helper auto-switches from main to feat/<slug>; RESEARCH.md and VALIDATION.md land on feat/ while the planner lands on docs/ — they share a common ancestor so fast-forward merge is always clean.
gsd-pattern-mapper writes PATTERNS.md but no plan-phase step commits it; it becomes an untracked orphan unless explicitly added outside the normal flow.
auto_chain_active flag must be cleared when invoking plan-phase manually (without --auto/--chain) to prevent unintended auto-advancement.
The TS API surface extractor returns empty for Rust-only phases and should be omitted from planner hints in that case.

Phase 59 has six detailed todo writeups in .planning/todos/pending/ with file/line-level findings on durability-critical FUSE Rust files; these are the authoritative spec in the absence of a CONTEXT.md.
The TEE republish path bypasses the embedded-sequence gate entirely (no TEE re-sign risk), but unifying FUSE to embed=1 is still recommended to allow removal of a verify.rs hotfix.
commit_failed from the commit helper is a known false-negative — commits succeed regardless.
workflow: Plan-checker blocks on Open Questions sections in RESEARCH.md that lack (RESOLVED) markers even when the answers are present in plan actions — always resolve markers before running the checker.
Plan-checker warns on VALIDATION.md per-task tables left as template stubs — fill automated commands from actual plan task IDs before the first checker run to avoid an extra iteration.
Mechanical doc fixes (missing markers, stub tables) do not require re-spawning the planner; fix directly and re-run the checker to clear the iteration count cheaply.
When plan-checker blockers are doc-level rather than plan defects, diagnose by reading the relevant section first, then edit in place rather than triggering a full planning revision.

friction: gsd-planner committed to a stray docs/plan-phase-59 branch, requiring manual branch consolidation and deletion after every planning run.
PATTERNS.md was left untracked because the plan-phase workflow has no commit step for it — required an out-of-band commit.
Plan-checker iteration 1 blocked on RESEARCH.md Open Questions missing (RESOLVED) markers, requiring a fix-and-recheck cycle.
Plan-checker iteration 1 warned on VALIDATION.md per-task table being a template stub, requiring extraction of all 8 task automated commands and a multi-edit fill.
commit_failed false-negative from the commit helper caused unnecessary verification steps to confirm commits actually landed.
open_items: Six todo writeups in .planning/todos/pending/ must be moved to .planning/todos/completed/ during phase execution (injected as a task in the final plan).
Unifying FUSE publish path to embed=1 is recommended to enable removal of the verify.rs hotfix but was deferred to phase execution.
Post-planning gap analysis ran at session end but results were not captured in the transcript.
